At the heart of the Cartographer is the Miyota 9075, a true traveler’s GMT automatic movement. Unlike an office-style GMT, the 9075 allows you to independently adjust your local hour hand in one-hour increments without stopping the watch or disturbing the minute hand. Travel across time zones, adjust your local time, and keep your home time displayed with the dedicated GMT hand and 24-hour scale. It’s a genuinely useful complication, whether you’re crossing the Atlantic or simply keeping track of someone a few time zones away. But we don’t stop at choosing the right movement. It’s a shape that changes depending on how you look at it. From above, the open lugs frame the dial with a distinctive architectural presence. From the side, the recessed case and flowing contours reveal depth and movement that conventional watch cases rarely attempt. The interplay between brushed and polished surfaces further emphasizes the case’s sculptural geometry, highlighting its curves and transitions as the light changes. These aren’t decorative elements attached to an otherwise standard watch. The architecture is the design. watches.description: EXPECTED DELIVERY: SECOND HALF OF 2027 60 purple/ 25 cherry blossom / 15 pistachio Total being made The Crane Field is currently in development. Before entering full production, we are producing and evaluating a physical prototype to make sure the final watch lives up to the concept Michael Crane and La Touraine set out to create. THE CRANE FIELD A Timepiece With a Purpose. The Crane Field is a hand-wound mechanical field watch created through a collaboration between Michael Crane and La Touraine Watches. But this project became about something much bigger than watches. Michael and I have both experienced the devastating loss of our mothers to pancreatic cancer. We know what this disease takes from families. We know what it means to wish you had more time. So we decided to create something together that could honor our mothers, recognize every family affected by pancreatic cancer, and help contribute to the fight against it. The Crane Field is that watch. Net proceeds from the Crane Field will be donated to Lustgarten Foundation for Pancreatic Cancer Research. Because of the charitable nature of this release, discount codes will not be accepted on purchases of the Crane Field. If one is submitted, the order will be canceled and refunded. TIME MEANS SOMETHING DIFFERENT WHEN YOU'VE LOST SOMEONE. A watch measures hours, minutes, and seconds. But anyone who has lost someone they love understands that time means far more than what appears on a dial. It is another conversation. Another birthday. Another holiday. Another ordinary afternoon you would give almost anything to have back. The Crane Field was created in memory of our mothers and in honor of the countless people and families whose lives have been changed by pancreatic cancer. Our hope is that this watch does more than preserve their memory. We hope it helps create more time for someone else's family. Remember the time you had. Help fight for more. A TRUE COLLABORATION The Crane Field was designed collaboratively by Michael Crane and La Touraine from the beginning. Rather than simply putting two names on an existing watch, we wanted to create something with its own identity. A compact mechanical field watch. A tactile dial unlike anything else in the La Touraine lineup. A hand-wound movement that makes interacting with the watch part of the experience. And subtle details throughout the design that connect the watch to the reason it exists. The result is a watch designed to be interesting enough for the enthusiast, practical enough for everyday wear, and meaningful enough to remind you why time matters. THREE DIALS. ONE STORY. The Crane Field will be available in three distinctive colors: Pistachio A muted, earthy green with a linen-inspired crumpled-paper texture that gives the dial natural depth and character. Cherry Blossom A warm, understated pink featuring a lightly crumpled-paper texture inspired by the imperfect, tactile character of handmade paper. Purple A distinctive purple dial combining linen and crumpled-paper textures for a layered appearance that changes subtly with the light. Each dial has been designed to feel tactile rather than glossy, with a paper-like surface that gives the Crane Field a personality all its own. No flat sunburst. No generic finish. These dials were meant to have texture you can see. DETAILS WITH MEANING The Crane Field carries its story throughout the watch rather than limiting it to an inscription on the back. The origami crane logo sits prominently at 12 o'clock, while the pancreatic cancer ribbon is incorporated into the lower portion of the dial. The printed Crane Field markings are designed with a subtle letterpress-inspired appearance, complementing the paper texture beneath them. An orange accent on the seconds hand provides a small but deliberate flash of color as it travels around the dial. Built around the spirit of that crossing, the Atlantica Automatic is durable, purposeful, and made for movement. Its clean no-date dial, brushed stainless steel bezel with engraved black markings, raised chapter-ring minute track, and Miyota 8215 automatic movement come together to create a versatile sport watch with genuine depth on the wrist. Crafted from 316L stainless steel and protected by sapphire crystal, the Atlantica is designed for daily wear, travel, and water-ready use. With 20 ATM / 660 ft water resistance, a jubilee-style stainless steel bracelet, quick-release spring bars, and a glide-lock-style adjustable clasp, it delivers a premium wearing experience at an approachable price. Four Dial Colors. Four Chapters of the Journey. The Atlantica Automatic is available in four distinct dial executions: Black Enamel Lacquer Navy Blue Sunburst Ombre British Racing Green Sunburst Ombre Purple Sunburst Ombre Each dial was created to shift with the light, adding visual depth and atmosphere inspired by the changing colors of sea, sky, and night across the Atlantic. Each color is limited to 100 pieces in the first production run and may be purchased individually.
